name: Mao Xue Woof 2026 Autumn Season
overview: Mao Xue  Woof premiered on Tencent Video on November 1, 2021, with new episodes released every Monday at 9 p.m. Starting March 20, 2023, the release time was adjusted to 6 p.m. every Monday. On January 29, 2024, the Winter Season ofMao Xue Wang aired, followed by the 2024 Spring Season on April 29, 2024. The show has maintained a consistent weekly release schedule year-round, offering companionship and emotional healing to young people striving hard in urban life. Since its debut,Mao Xue Wang has won multiple awards, including "2021 Pan-Lifestyle Variety Show" at the 2021 Weibo Awards and "2021 Innovative Variety Show" at the 6th New Entertainment Awards. On August 3, 2026,Mao Xue Wang 2026 Autumn Season premiered.
